verdict.rationale: The evidence covers versioning of the platform, not of user automations. Pinned, dated model IDs and API-version guarantees let an automation stay on a known model and be moved back to it, and Skills are filesystem-based, so they could be versioned and reviewed with external tools like git. Nothing documents first-party versioning, review, or rollback of user-built automations such as Managed Agents configurations. Missing for 10: native version history for agents and automations, a review or approval workflow for automation changes, one-step rollback of automation definitions, and hands-on corroboration.
